items.title: Football: Suarez Earns Sun Belt Weekly Honor
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison kicker Morgan Suarez has been named the Sun Belt Conference Special Teams Player of the Week, the league announced on Monday.

items.title: Football: Evans Leads Dukes in Road Win at Southern Miss
items.summary: HATTIESBURG, Miss. – James Madison scored 38 second-half points to push the Dukes to a 54-23 win over Southern Miss on Thursday night at Renasant Stadium in Hattiesburg, Mississippi.

items.title: Football: Rea Named to Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison punter Patrick Rea has been named to the Ray Guy Award Midseason Watch List, the Augusta Sports Council announced on Wednesday.

items.title: Football: Third Straight Thursday Game Takes JMU to Southern Miss
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison plays its third straight midweek game by traveling to Southern Miss on Thursday, Nov. 5. Kickoff at Renasant Stadium in Hattiesburg, Mississippi, is set for 8 p.m. ET, and the game will air live on ESPN2.

items.title: Football: Dukes Drop Second Straight in OT
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison was plagued by turnovers in a 24-21, overtime loss to Troy on Thursday night at Bridgeforth Stadium.

items.title: Football: JMU Takes on Troy in Sun Belt Championship Rematch
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison is back at home for a 2025 Sun Belt Conference Championship Game rematch against Troy on Thursday, Oct. 29. Kickoff at Bridgeforth Stadium is set for 7:30 p.m. ET, and the game will be aired live on ESPN2.

items.title: Football: Dukes Fall to App State in Overtime
items.summary: BOONE, N.C. – James Madison suffered its first loss of the 2026 campaign on Thursday night at App State, falling 34-31 in overtime.

items.title: Football: Napier Earns Spot on Bear Bryant Coach of the Year Watch List
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison coach Billy Napier has been named to the Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year Watch List, the American Heart Association announced on Wednesday.

items.title: Football: Scott Collects Midseason All-America Honors
items.summary: HARRISONBURG, Va. – James Madison wide receiver Michael Scott has been named to The Sporting News Midseason All-America Team, the organization announced on Wednesday.

items.title: Football, Administration: Impacts to Game Day and Campus Operations for Thursday Night JMU Football Game (Oct. 29)
items.summary: JMU and JMU Athletics announces campus operational plan for Oct. 29 Thursday Night football game. Game day parking will begin at 4:30pm.
